programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Khakee: The Real Police
programme.desc: When a drug lord ransoms police officer Diwakar's son for a bag of cocaine, he has no choice but to steal it from police headquarters. However, this raises the suspicions of his colleague Mallika.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Aunty 420
programme.desc: In order to see his little girl more often, a divorcee disguises himself as an old lady and gets a job as his own daughter's caretaker.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's magical realist novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: A downtrodden handyman is forced to look after his niece and nephew. He soon wins them over with his knack for telling exciting stories, but to their surprise the tall tales start coming true - and as the children make their own suggestions, the results become even more incredible. Fantasy comedy, starring Adam Sandler, Keri Russell, Guy Pearce and Russell Brand.

programme.title: Wall-e
programme.desc: A waste-collecting robot becomes humanity's last hope when it finds a sustainable plant living amongst the ruins. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ben Burtt, Elissa Knight, Jeff Garlin, Fred Willard and John Ratzenberger.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: A teenage girl finds herself pregnant after a one-night stand with her best friend. Deciding to give her baby up for adoption, she thinks she has found the perfect parents in a yuppie couple. However, over the next nine months she begins to experience doubts about her plans. Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. She joins them in their acts of sabotage, but finds her loyalties changing as she forms connections with members of the group. Thriller, starring Brit Marling, Elliot Page and Alexander Skarsgard.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: A wizard living secretly in modern-day New York vows to prevent his mystical enemy from taking over the city. Realising that he is unable to complete the task alone, he recruits an ordinary teenager to be his assistant, teaching him to master the magical arts. Fantasy adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Jay Baruchel and Alfred Molina.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Alien: Romulus
programme.desc: While scavenging items from a derelict space station, a group of young colonisers fight for survival when they cross paths with lethal life forms. Co-writer/director Fede Alvarez's horror sequel set between the events of Alien and Aliens, starring Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson and Isabela Merced.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred `House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at `Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson,who runs `Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to nightshift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny in inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their `Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred `The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from `The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango puree filled doughnuts for his dessert `Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart `Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the South East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they re-make their `Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three talented newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision which she has gained from working her entire career at 2 Michelin-starred restaurant Andrew Fairlie at Gleneagles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross is hoping to snatch victory with his dish `Lobster Aid'. Lorna's `Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements, each of which she needs to deliver perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ross is hoping to impress with `Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and the last chance for the chefs to impress before one is sent home. Ross is attempting to elevate a comfort classic into a dish worthy of the banquet. Lorna's cooking a personal tribute to the NHS staff who have cared for her during treatment for a rare blood condition, using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours. Once again Ben is serving an experimental dish with his `Dance for the Greater Good' which includes a bees wax ice cream.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness. Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils. While Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and following yesterday's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her `carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat `A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four course menus.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his innovative take on a traditional healing recipe, `Mum's Flu Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's `A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed. And Chris is hoping to impress with his dish inspired by a therapeutic hospital garden featuring foraged herbs from the Welsh valley where he lives including wild chervil, pickled pine buds and yarrow tips.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's `Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's `For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with `Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the South West, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an `Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his `An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head to head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the North West in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the North West chefs to impress in a bid to make it through to the regional final. Liam is cooking `Not So Hot Toddy' in honour of a friend who works nightshifts in the NHS, while Ellis' `Worth Their Weight in Gold' is dedicated to the staff who saved his brother's life and Craig's dish `The Missed Celebration' pays tribute to his wife with an unusual Christmas concept.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two highest scoring chefs from the week return to cook their menus again. Judging them are Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton and Andi Oliver who are joined by Dr Jake Dunning MBE, an infectious disease specialist who has been recognised for his work during the West Africa Ebola epidemic.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs are doing battle to represent Northern Ireland. Tommy Heaney, Head Chef at the Great House Hotel in South Wales is taken on by Shauna Froydenlund, Chef Patron at Marcus Waring's two Michelin starred restaurant and James Devine, the 2017 National Chef of the Year.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course, the chefs return to the kitchen to cook their fish dishes. James is making his elevated take on a fried chicken takeaway as a tribute to the NHS staff who care for his sister. Shauna is also taking inspiration from a personal connection with a tribute to staff from a facility in her hometown of Londonderry. Tommy is hoping to impress with a dish dedicated to the discovery of DNA.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With two courses down it's time for the chefs to cook their main courses. It's the battle of beef with each using the same meat in their innovative creations. Tommy also meets the first baby ever born on the NHS.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert course and the final chance for the chefs to impress. After such a tightly fought battle all week, each is hoping to deliver a technically perfect dessert. Tommy and James are both using passion fruit in their complex dishes while Shauna is hoping to use her pastry chef training to score full marks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs representing Northern Ireland go head to head. Judging as ever are Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver who are joined by Shehan Hettiaratchy, lead trauma surgeon at St Mary's Hospital who helped treat victims of the Grenfell Tower fire.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs from all 8 regions must now battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's `Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.Each day the regional champions will be cooking one of their courses again for the discerning panel of judges.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs must cook their fish courses but after some exceptionally high scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection in order to see off the competition. Once again the chefs present their innovative, witty or heart warming creations, with lobster, mackerel, John Dory, turbot and hake among the dishes being scrutinized.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three hundred year old Great Hall.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the nation's greatest chefs battle for the chance to cook a glittering Olympic banquet. The feast will honour the hopes and achievements of the country's sporting heroes, and it will be a glorious celebration of Britain's culinary talents. This time it is the battle of the Scottish chefs - returning contender Alan Murchison and newcomers Colin Buchan and Mark Greenaway.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning contender Alan Murchison and newcomers Colin Buchan and Mark Greenaway must cook their fish course, but which one will prevail? Will it be grilled mackerel with beetroot meringues and horseradish ice cream, crab `cannelloni' or poached halibut with squid ink? Great British Menu veteran Jeremy Lee will decide who goes through to the judges.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Sir Matthew Pinsent takes time out to meet one of the chefs and give them valuable tips on competing at the highest level. All three chefs are determined to knock out their rivals in the race to the banquet. This is the big one, the main course, but which one will get top marks? Will it be barbecued veal with macaroni cheese, spinach and watercress; beef rump and terrine; or loin of blackface lamb with sweetbreads?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scottish chefs - returning contender Alan Murchison and newcomers Colin Buchan and Mark Greenaway. All of them are determined to knock out their rivals in the race to the banquet. This is the final chance to impress `Great British Menu' veteran Jeremy Lee with their dessert dishes - `Going for Gold', modern day Eton mess, and beetroot cake with chocolate mousse and fennel ice cream.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is decision time for the chefs from Scotland. The two remaining chefs cook their entire menus for the `Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The judges aren't easily pleased and only world class cooking will do. Only one chef can make it through to the national finals to represent Scotland. If they win, one of their dishes could be on the menu at The Olympic Feast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Central chefs Aktar Islam and Daniel Clifford and newcomer Paul Foster kick things off with their starters, but which one is going to be first off the blocks? Will it be pork neck with ribwort plantain and pork scratchings, veal tartare with caramelised sweetbread and burnt onions or breast of squab with confit leg and chilli and sweetcorn shoots?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chefs Aktar Islam, Daniel Clifford and Paul Foster cook their fish course, but which one will prevail? Will it be poached ray wing with chicken skin and sea vegetables, stuffed red mullet with roasted artichoke and parmesan puree, or pickled mackerel with smoked langoustine and infused coconut milk?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: S1 E2 — La Dolce VardyAfter an emotional farewell to their home and family in the UK, Becky and the kids make the move to Italy, taking everything with them - including their dogs and grand piano. But Italian life is immediately complicated, with a frustrated Jamie injured and unable to play but desperate to start scoring goals for his new club. The kids love their new Italian home but struggle being away from friends.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: S1 E3 — To Stay or to Go?Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision - whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home.

programme.title: Emergency Nurses: A&E Stories
programme.desc: S2 E10Nurse Jo identifies with a young asthma patient, the team tend to an elderly couple involved in a joint accident, and Charlie celebrates her engagement.

programme.title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Street FoodJason celebrates Dubai-style quick bites and food on the go, showcasing oysters with a spicy Asian-inspired dressing, and grilled corn with chilli and parmesan. He is joined by Hattem Mattar, who cooks macaroni cheese with spicy lamb sausages over an open wood fire.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E5 — DerryDermot O'Leary visits Londonderry, where he heads to the Walled City brewery to find out about the local ingredient behind their standout brews. He then gets in a kayak to take in the skyline from a whole new angle, before getting hands-on with chef Kevin Pyke at Pyke 'N' Pommes, preparing calamari and building tacos.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S8 E22Joining Alan at Manor Farm are actor Stephen Tompkinson and West End and Broadway star Kerry Ellis, and there is a look behind the scenes at the Globe Theatre ahead of their summer season. Plus, wine expert Toni Osoba has the very best in summer sparkles.

programme.title: Ainsley's Fantastic Flavours
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Cosy & ComfortingAinsley Harriott demonstrates cosy and comforting recipes, making a sumptuous beef stroganoff puff pastry pie and classic bread and butter pudding with a twist. On his Mediterranean adventures, Ainsley takes a stroll through the historic city of Valetta, while Charlotte Dawson pops in for a taste of Ainsley's warming penne con pollo.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E6 — North DonegalDermot O'Leary travels to Letterkenny in Co Donegal, discovering a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: S13 E9 — Jayde Adams, Tony Cottee, Naughty Boy and the VivienneBradley Walsh presents as Jayde Adams, Tony Cottee, Naughty Boy and the Vivienne pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. programme.title: Live International Football
programme.desc: S7 E5 — England v New Zealand 06.06England v New Zealand (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the friendly at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Florida. This is the first of two warm-up games for England before their FIFA World Cup campaign begins on 17th June against Croatia. Their opponents also qualified for the finals and they begin their tournament two days earlier against Iran. These teams last met back in 1991, when England prevailed 1-0 in Auckland and 2-0 in Wellington. With analysis from Roy Keane and Karen Carney, pitchside inserts from Ian Wright and Gabriel Clarke, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: Action sequel starring Liam Neeson. Former CIA agent Bryan Mills plans a few days in Istanbul with his daughter and ex-wife. But the father of a kidnapper he killed is hellbent on revenge and so once again the lives of Mills and his family are in peril.

programme.title: Josie's Taste of the Westcountry
programme.desc: S1 E4 — DevonJosie Gibson visits Devon, the county where national parks and beaches abound, to find out about some of the old legends of Dartmoor. programme.title: Alan Titchmarsh's Gardening Club

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E14 — ArlesThe chef arrives in the city of Arles, famous for its Roman architecture and the largest market in Provence. He also has a go at pottery with a local ceramicist, visits an award-winning wine producer - who causes him to rethink the merits of rose wine - and heads to an olive grove where he cooks fried lamb chops with baby aubergines.

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the first of a two-part documentary, the naturalist explores the origins of life on Earth. Beginning the journey near his childhood home in Charnwood Forest, Leicestershire, he learns how a fossil discovery transformed scientists' understanding of the evolution of complex organisms, and in Newfoundland and Australia he reveals the earliest kinds of animal to exist on the planet. With the help of cutting-edge technology and visual effects, the programme brings the creatures to life, demonstrating how they survived

programme.title: David Attenborough's First Life
programme.desc: In the conclusion of the two-part documentary, the naturalist travels to Burgess Shale in Canada's Rocky Mountains, where he explores how evolution gained pace once creatures developed mouths and mobility. In Scotland, he reveals that one of the smallest fossils found holds the secret to how animals began surviving on dry land, and explains the bloom of life during the oxygen-rich Carboniferous period

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Part one of two. The reasons why young animals enjoy playing, and how it can teach them to survive in the wild. The programme explores how young elephants, which rarely leave their mothers' side for the first eight years of life, play to develop social skills, while macaques hone their mental agility by playing games with stones. Plus, a zoologist who looks after orphaned cheetahs reveals how play can help cubs learn to hunt

programme.title: Animals at Play
programme.desc: Part two of two. The secrets behind animals' group games, from dolphins that play catch to a hyena tug of war, revealing the benefits they gain from their playful behaviour. The programme examines how breaching the rules of a game can have fatal consequences - but how it also presents an opportunity for animals with a rigid hierarchy to break down social barriers

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E3A social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement during the 1920s and the NSDAP use emotions to gain the loyalty of the people.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E4President Hindenburg suspends freedom of speech and Hitler comes to power in 1933. The first concentration camps for political opponents are set up.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1Viking combat ships changed the course of history. Their longships brought William the Conqueror’s troops to Hastings, adventurers to North America and raiders to plunder the Saxon kingdoms.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2In Stealth we examine the methods ships have used to evade detection. With the advent of radar in WW2, ships that wanted to remain undetected had to find ways to hide.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E7Encouraged by Nazi brutality, Soviet partisans took up arms, creating big 'no-go' areas for German troops. This is a look at their efforts from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E8Stalin’s USSR was highly experienced in espionage. Yet Hitler’s invasion still caught the Soviets off-guard. Thereafter, though, the GRU and NKVD went on to score amazing intelligence coups in Tokyo, Washington and even the heart of Berlin.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Commando Missions

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E5After a poor start to the war, the Soviet Air Force fought back with brilliant aircraft designs. This is a look at their domination of the skies from the Russian viewpoint.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E6The Soviet Union's submarines courted huge controversy in 1945 when they caused massive losses of life at sea. This is a look at the naval war from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: D Day: 100 Days To Beat The Third Reich
programme.desc: E1This documentary will bring back to life the 100 days it took for the Allies to liberate Normandy, to break through the German line and to pave the way towards victory. 100 critical days, both heroic and tragic, that made history.
